integrations.description: Weather places and news feeds that weather and RSS widgets show. WallX Play fetches and caches them for all your screens.
integrations.notInPlanTitle: Weather and RSS are not included in your plan
integrations.notInPlanBody: Upgrade to a plan with weather and RSS widgets to show live weather and headlines on screens.
integrations.emptyTitle: No weather places or feeds yet
integrations.emptyBody: Add a weather place or an RSS feed, then show it with a weather or RSS widget in Layout Studio.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.nameHint: Shown on screens as the place name.
integrations.howTo: To show one on a screen, open Layout Studio, select a zone and choose Weather or RSS under Content.
integrations.searchHint: For example Pune, Nashik or Bengaluru.
integrations.noPlaces: No place found. Try another spelling or a nearby city.
integrations.feedHint: The RSS or Atom address of a news site or blog (often ends in /rss or /feed).
integrations.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Widgets cannot use it any more.

dataWidgets.noSources: Weather and RSS widgets need a place or feed. Add one on the Integrations page first.
